themes.label: AI accelerating development goals
themes.definition: AI's rapid development framed as offering great opportunities to accelerate development goals, conditional on proper governance.
themes.inclusion: Passages stating AI can accelerate SDGs or development.
themes.boundary_cases: Conditional opportunity statements tied to governance also take AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: the rapid development of artificial intelligence offers great opportunities to accelerate development goals

themes.label: Equitable global AI governance
themes.definition: Calls for comprehensive and equitable global governance ensuring responsible AI use.
themes.inclusion: Passages calling for comprehensive, equitable or inclusive global AI governance.
themes.boundary_cases: Governance framed around North-South equity also takes AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: accompanied by comprehensive and equitable global governance that ensure that responsible use

themes.label: Preventing North-South AI divide
themes.definition: Concern that AI widens the digital divide between North and South.
themes.inclusion: Passages on preventing a North-South digital or AI divide.
themes.boundary_cases: When remedies are listed, also code AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: prevents the widening of the digital divide between North and South

themes.label: Capacity building, transfer and financing
themes.definition: Remedies for AI inequality through capacity building, technology transfer, adequate financing, and fairer access to finance for digital transformation.
themes.inclusion: Passages naming capacity building, technology transfer or financing for AI/digital development.
themes.boundary_cases: Financial architecture reform enabling technology investment counts when linked to AI.

examples.quote: through capacity building, technology transfer, and adequate financing

value.rationale: The single Tunisian passage embeds AI in a development-finance argument: AI can accelerate development only with equitable global governance, preventing a North-South divide through capacity building, technology transfer and financing.
